qualityPolicy: Original upload URL reconstructed from the exact MediaWiki thumbnail URL by removing /thumb/ and the final thumbnail component; source bytes preserved. All distinct linked variants retained. Sample original-file pages checked. This is the maximum upload available at these gallery URLs, not a claim about unseen scans elsewhere.
scope: All file-linked illustrations and source scans from Frosti Berserk Art Gallery and Berserk Gallery, including supplementary infobox art; navigation icons and separate TCG/Tribute galleries excluded.
dateNotes: Dates are reproduced from the gallery; imprecise years, decades and ranges use their first year for sorting, and remain visibly marked as approximate.
The source labels a 1991 magazine preview May 25, 1989; preserved verbatim rather than silently corrected.
Undated supplementary entries use exact shared-image matches or an explicitly documented collection publication date; otherwise they remain undated.
